paragraphs: Hewlett Packard Enterprise is a global technology leader focused on developing intelligent solutions that allow customers to capture, analyze and act upon data seamlessly from edge to cloud. We enable our customers to accelerate business outcomes by driving new business models, creating new customer and employee experiences, and increasing operational efficiency today and into the future. Our customers range from small-and-medium-sized businesses to large global enterprises and governmental entities. Our legacy dates back to a partnership founded in 1939 by William R. Hewlett and David Packard, and we strive every day to uphold and enhance that legacy through our dedication to providing innovative technological solutions to our customers.
We use the terms "Hewlett Packard Enterprise," "HPE," "the Company," "we," "us," and "our" to refer to Hewlett Packard Enterprise Company.

Over the last several years, HPE has observed megatrends around networking, cloud, data, and artificial intelligence ("AI") emerging to shape customer expectations for enterprise technology. The megatrends are ushering in long-lasting changes to how enterprises are consuming technology and setting up their IT infrastructures, including accelerating implementation of AI and hybrid multi-cloud adoption. Data at the edge is increasing exponentially, and in this data disaggregated environment, enterprises need a holistic and integrated cloud experience to manage their distributed data and workloads. AI has emerged as a powerful tool to more intelligently and quickly deliver meaningful business insights and opportunities. As such, customers across industry verticals are interested in incorporating AI into their operations and unifying all of their applications and data with a consistent cloud experience, both of which require a secure, reliable, and intelligent network infrastructure.

We have deployed a strategy that seeks to capitalize on these emergent megatrends and deliver a data-first modernization approach for customers. Our innovative solutions are deployed across networking, cloud, and AI use cases, and have shifted our mix of products and services and the way we deliver that mix to customers. We have also evolved our business to a platform-based model, fueled by a portfolio that is richer in software and services.

Networking has become truly mission critical, not just for connecting infrastructure, data and users, but also for powering the next wave of AI-driven innovation across a variety of every industries. The AI market requires a modern and high-performing networking fabric as a core foundation to deliver a more efficient data-center cloud, which we offer through our AI-native portfolio of networking solutions. We intend to drive innovation through "AI for Networks"— which we define as using AI to make networks smarter — and "Networks for AI"— which builds the foundational infrastructure for next-generation AI applications. Our acquisition of Juniper Networks, Inc. ("Juniper Networks") advances this strategy giving HPE a full networking technology stack and enabling us to deliver secure, AI-driven networking solutions.

In cloud, we have redefined this portion of the market by delivering an experience that is hybrid by design with our HPE GreenLake cloud. As a centerpiece of our strategy, it accelerates multi-generation IT transformation through a unified cloud-native and AI-driven experience that empowers customers to access, analyze, and extract value from their data across public clouds, data centers, colocation facilities, and at the edge. The HPE GreenLake cloud is designed to deliver a seamless hybrid experience with true pay-per-use consumption and automated scalability. We continue to evaluate and expand upon HPE GreenLake's capabilities with new software offerings and virtualization solutions to accelerate higher-margin growth. In addition, HPE is driving a transition to proprietary HPE-developed storage solutions that enhance profitability and reduce reliance on third-party products.

We recognize that the AI market will be driven by computational capability, data-intensive workloads, and the need for specialized architecture. In AI infrastructure, HPE is focused on sovereign and enterprise customers, leveraging our supercomputing heritage and turnkey AI factory solutions, including HPE Private Cloud AI and scalable AI servers. With decades of large-scale infrastructure expertise defining our offerings, including technologies like fanless direct liquid cooling that power our largest AI systems, HPE's server business supports both traditional servers and those that enable AI workloads.

We complement this expertise with our market-leading supercomputing portfolio of HPE Cray EX solutions and systems. HPE ProLiant servers and rack scale solutions deliver sustainable accelerated computing for training and inferencing deployed at scale across the market. We believe that we are differentiated from our competition by a unique and compelling value proposition in the growing AI market through our intellectual property portfolio, trusted expertise, and long-term sustained market leadership in supercomputing. An additional point of differentiation for HPE is our global manufacturing services footprint, which allows us to compete around the world.

Finally, our financial services business complements our solution offerings by helping customers unlock financial capacity. This business offers customers the ability to accelerate adoption of AI through financing options from us as well as through IT life cycle services.

Our operations are organized into five reportable business segments: Server, Hybrid Cloud, Networking, Financial Services, and Corporate Investments and Other. The classes of similar product categories within each segment which accounted for more than 10% of our consolidated net revenue in each of the past three years were as follows:
•Fiscal 2025 - Server products, Networking products
•Fiscal 2024 - Server products, Server services, Networking products, Hybrid Cloud products
•Fiscal 2023 - Server products, Networking products, Server services, Hybrid Cloud products
The Company had one distributor which represented approximately 10% of the Company's total net revenue in fiscal 2025, primarily within the Server and Networking segments.

headings: Risks Related to Our Business Strategy and Industry
Risks Related to Our Technology and Business Operations
We operate in an intensely competitive industry, and competitive pressures could harm our business and financial performance.
Uncertainty and fluctuations in geopolitical and macroeconomic conditions may adversely impact our business, financial condition, and operating results.
If we experience or fail to properly manage disruption in the distribution of our products and services properly, our business and financial performance could suffer.
Business disruptions could seriously harm our future revenue and financial condition and increase our costs and expenses.
Long sales and implementation cycles for our offerings and dynamics related to large orders may cause our revenues and operating results to vary significantly from quarter-to-quarter.
Our uneven sales cycle and supply chain disruptions make planning and inventory management difficult and future financial results less predictable.
paragraphs: You should carefully consider the following risks and other information in this Annual Report on Form 10-K in evaluating Hewlett Packard Enterprise. Any of the following risks could materially and adversely affect our results of operations or financial condition. Some of the factors, events, and contingencies discussed below may have occurred in the past, but the disclosures below are not representations as to whether or not the factors, events or contingencies have occurred in the past and instead reflect our beliefs and opinions as to the factors, events, or contingencies that could materially and adversely affect us in the future. The following risk factors should be read in conjunction with Part II, Item 7, "Management's Discussion and Analysis of Financial Condition and Results of Operation," and the Consolidated Financial Statements and related notes in Part II, Item 8, "Financial Statements and Supplementary Data" of this Annual Report Form 10-K.
The following is a summary of the principal risks that could adversely affect our business, operations, and financial results.

•Our success depends on our ability to successfully execute our go-to-market strategy, including offering solutions as-a-Service, effectively planning and managing our resources, and continuing to develop and manage our offerings to integrate new features and solutions.

•We depend on third-party suppliers, contract manufacturers (including original equipment and original design manufacturers), as well as single-source and limited source suppliers, and our financial results could suffer if we fail to manage these third party relationships effectively.

•System security risks, data protection incidents, cyberattacks and systems integration issues could disrupt our internal operations or IT services provided to customers, and any such disruption could reduce our revenue, increase our expenses, damage our reputation, and adversely affect our stock price.
•We operate in an intensely competitive industry, and competitive pressures could harm our business and financial performance

paragraphs: For purposes of this Management's Discussion and Analysis of Financial Condition and Results of Operations ("MD&A") section, we use the terms "Hewlett Packard Enterprise," "HPE," "the Company," "we," "us," and "our" to refer to Hewlett Packard Enterprise Company.

This section of this Form 10-K generally discusses fiscal 2025 and fiscal 2024 items and year-to-year comparisons between fiscal 2025 and fiscal 2024. Discussions of fiscal 2023 items and year-to-year comparisons between fiscal 2024 and fiscal 2023 that are not included in this Form 10-K can be found in "Part II, Item 7, Management's Discussion and Analysis of Financial Condition and Results of Operations" of the Company's Annual Report on Form 10-K for the fiscal year October 31, 2024, as filed with the SEC on December 19, 2024, which is available on the SEC's website at www.sec.gov.

We intend the discussion of our financial condition and results of operations that follows to provide information that will assist the reader in understanding our Consolidated Financial Statements, changes in certain key items in these financial statements from year to year, and the primary factors that accounted for these changes, as well as how certain accounting principles, policies and estimates affect our Consolidated Financial Statements. This discussion should be read in conjunction with our Consolidated Financial Statements and the related notes that appear elsewhere in this document.

•Trends and Uncertainties. A discussion of material events and uncertainties known to management, such as the mixed macroeconomic environment and heightening global trade restrictions, uneven demand across our portfolio, increased demand for and adoption of new technologies, increased inventory levels, conservative customer spending environment (though recovering), persistent inflation, foreign exchange pressures, recent tax developments, and competitive pricing pressures.

•Executive Overview. A discussion of our business and a summary of our financial performance and other highlights, including non-GAAP financial measures, affecting the Company in order to provide context to the remainder of the MD&A.

•Critical Accounting Policies and Estimates. A discussion of accounting policies and estimates that we believe are important to understanding the assumptions and judgments incorporated in our reported financial results.
•Results of Operations. A discussion of the results of operations at the consolidated level is followed by a discussion of the results of operations at the segment level.
•Liquidity and Capital Resources. An analysis of changes in our cash flows, financial condition, liquidity, and cash requirements and commitments.

•GAAP to Non-GAAP Reconciliations. Each non-GAAP financial measure has been reconciled to the most directly comparable GAAP financial measure. This section also includes a discussion of the use, usefulness and economic substance of the non-GAAP financial measures, along with a discussion of material limitations, and compensation for those limitations, associated with the use of non-GAAP financial measures.
During fiscal 2025, the effects of the evolving macroeconomic environment on demand persisted and certain significant developments impacted our operations as follows:

Technological Advancements: We have observed market trends and demand (of customers of various segments and sizes) gravitating towards AI, hybrid cloud, edge computing, data security capabilities, and related offerings. The volume of data at the edge continues to grow, driven by the proliferation of more devices. The need for a unified cloud experience everywhere has grown, as well, in order to manage the growth of data at the edge. Increasing demand for AI is also contributing to changes in the competitive landscape. With the abundance of data, there are opportunities to develop AI tools with powerful computational abilities to extract insights and value from the captured data. Secure networking that is purpose-built for AI workloads is the foundation that enables users to seamlessly connect and apply AI learnings to such data that lives in various ecosystems. While we believe our recent acquisition of Juniper Networks positions us to capitalize on the growing market opportunities across AI-accelerated computing, data, cloud and networking, our major competitors and emerging competitors are expanding their product and service offerings with integrated products and solutions and exerting increased competitive pressure. We expect these market dynamics and trends to continue in the longer term.
HEWLETT PACKARD ENTERPRISE COMPANY AND SUBSIDIARIES

Macroeconomic Uncertainty: The evolving macroeconomic environment has impacted industry-wide demand, as customers have been taking longer to work through prior orders and, to this day, have been adopting a more strategic approach to discretionary IT spending. While this dynamic has been easing, this has resulted in uneven demand across our portfolio and geographies, particularly for certain of our hardware offerings, as customers have focused investments on modernizing infrastructure, such as migrating to cloud-based offerings, including our own. Additionally, there continues to be significant uncertainty surrounding the tariff environment and import/export regulations due to numerous factors, including but not limited to tariff imposition delays, changes to tariff rates and policies, and enactment of reciprocally restrictive trade policies and measures around the world. These have enhanced global trade uncertainty and contributed to higher prices of components and end products and services. While we have sought to mitigate these adverse impacts by relying on our global supply chain and implementing pricing measures, we expect such a mixed macroeconomic environment to largely continue and possibly limit revenue and margin growth in the near term.

Supply Chain: We experienced supply chain constraints for certain components, including graphics processing units ("GPUs") and accelerated processing units. Though they have eased at times during the fiscal year, we are once again experiencing such constraints and expect such dynamics to continue in the medium term. The future remains uncertain due to the macroeconomic dynamics discussed above, which have thus far impacted our ability to import and export components and finished products and the costs of doing so. Additionally, logistics costs have been, and may continue to remain, high with such changes in trade policies. We have been experiencing higher-than-normal inventory levels, primarily due to frequent component part updates, customers transitioning to the next generation of GPUs, our securing supply ahead of demand, and longer customer acceptance timelines on AI-related orders. While we have been working to reduce inventory, any or all of the aforementioned factors could contribute to sustained higher-than-normal levels and further uncertainty. We have experienced, and expect to continue experiencing, rising input component costs due to various factors, including but not limited to the global trade uncertainties referenced above and a competitive pricing environment, all of which may impact our financial results. We plan to mitigate the impact of these dynamics through continued disciplined cost and pricing management and supply chain diversification; however, such actions may not be successful.

headings: 本公司應報告分部、產品與服務
paragraphs: 惠普企業（Hewlett Packard Enterprise）為全球科技領導者，專注於開發智慧解決方案，使客戶能從邊緣到雲端無縫地捕捉、分析並採取行動。我們協助客戶加速業務成果，透過推動新業務模式、創造新客戶與員工體驗，並提高現有與未來的運營效率。我們的客戶範圍從中小企業到大型全球企業與政府機構。我們的歷史可追溯至1939年由威廉·R·惠普與戴維·帕卡德創立的合作關係，我們致力於透過提供創新科技解決方案來維持並提升這段遺產。
我們使用「Hewlett Packard Enterprise」、「HPE」、「the Company」、「we」、「us」和「our」這幾個詞來指稱惠普企業公司。

在過去幾年，HPE觀察到網路、雲端、數據與人工智慧（"AI"）等宏觀趨勢正在形成，這些趨勢正在塑造企業科技的客戶期待。這些宏觀趨勢正在引發企業如何採用科技與設置其資訊科技基礎設施的長遠改變，包括加速人工智慧的實作與混合多雲的採用。邊緣的數據正在指數成長，而在這數據分散的環境中，企業需要一個整體且整合的雲端體驗來管理其分散的數據與工作負載。人工智慧已成為一種強大的工具，能更智慧且快速地提供有意義的業務洞察與機會。因此，各產業垂直的客戶都對將人工智慧納入其運作並統一所有應用與數據，以一致的雲端體驗感興趣，這兩者都需要一個安全、可靠且智慧的網路基礎設施。
我們已部署了一項策略，旨在利用這些新興的宏觀趨勢，為客戶提供以數據為先的現代化方案。我們的創新解決方案應用於網路、雲端與人工智慧的使用案例，並已改變我們的產品與服務組合，以及我們如何向客戶交付這組合。我們也已將業務模式轉型為平台模式，並透過軟體與服務更豐富的產品組合來推動。

網路已成為真正關鍵的業務，不僅僅是連接基礎設施、數據與用戶，也用於驅動各產業的AI創新浪潮。AI市場需要現代化且高性能的網路架構作為核心基礎，以提供更高效的資料中心雲端，我們透過我們的AI原生網路解決方案來提供此種服務。我們意圖透過「AI for Networks」— 我們定義為利用AI使網路更智慧 — 以及「Networks for AI」— 建立下一代AI應用的基礎基礎設施 — 來推動創新。我們收購Juniper Networks, Inc.（"JunpNet"）進展了此策略，使HPE擁有完整的網路科技堆疊，並能提供安全、AI驅動的網路解決方案。

在雲端方面，我們重新定義了此市場的部份，透過HPE GreenLake雲端提供混合設計的體驗。作為我們策略的核心，它透過統一的雲端原生與AI驅動體驗加速多世代IT轉型，使客戶能從公有雲端、資料中心、共用空間與邊緣存取、分析並提取其數據價值。HPE GreenLake雲端設計為提供無縫的混合體驗，並具備真正的按使用付費消費與自動化擴展功能。我們持續評估並擴展HPE GreenLake的功能，透過新的軟體產品與虛擬化解決方案來加速高毛利率成長。此外，HPE正推動轉向專屬HPE開發的儲存解決方案，以提高利潤並減少對第三方產品的依賴。

我們認知到AI市場將由計算能力、數據密集型工作負載與專門架構的需求所驅動。在AI基礎設施方面，HPE專注於主權與企業客戶，利用我們的超級計算遺產與端到端AI工廠解決方案，包括HPE Private Cloud AI與可擴展的AI伺服器。憑藉數十年的大型基礎設施專業知識來定義我們的產品，包括如無風扇直接液冷技術，這些技術驅動我們最大的AI系統，HPE的伺服器業務支援傳統伺服器與能處理AI工作負載的伺服器。
我們以我們市場領先的超級計算產品組合HPE Cray EX解決方案與系統來補強這項專業知識。HPE ProLiant伺服器與機架規模解決方案提供可持續的加速計算，用於市場規模的訓練與推理部署。我們相信我們在成長中的AI市場中與競爭對手的差異化在於我們的智慧財產權組合、受信的專業知識與在超級計算領域的長期持續市場領導地位。HPE的另一個差異化點是我們的全球製造服務據點，使我們能在世界各地競爭。
最後，我們的財務服務業務透過協助客戶釋放財務潛能，補足我們的解決方案業務。此業務讓客戶能透過我們的融資選項以及資訊科技生命週期服務，加速採用人工智慧。
我們的業務運作分為五個應報告分部：伺服器、混合雲、網路、財務服務，以及企業投資與其他。過去三年內，每個分部內銷售額超過我們合併淨銷售額 10% 的相似產品類別如下：
• 財務 2025 年 - 伺服器產品、網路產品
• 財務 2024 年 - 伺服器產品、伺服器服務、網路產品、混合雲產品
• 財務 2023 年 - 伺服器產品、網路產品、伺服器服務、混合雲產品
本公司在財務 2025 年時，有一家經銷商佔本公司總淨銷售額約 10%，主要為伺服器與網路分部的業務。

paragraphs: 為使本「管理層討論與分析財務狀況及營運結果」(「MD&A」) 部分之說明更清楚，我們使用「Hewlett Packard Enterprise」、「HPE」、「本公司」、「我們」、「我們」及「我們」這些詞彙來指稱 Hewlett Packard Enterprise Company。

本 Form 10-K 文件之此部分一般討論財務年度 2025 年及財務年度 2024 年之項目，以及財務年度 2025 年與財務年度 2024 年之間的年對年比較。有關財務年度 2023 年之項目及財務年度 2024 年與財務年度 2023 年之間的年對年比較，若未包含於本 Form 10-K 文件中，可參閱本公司於 2024 年 10 月 31 日財務年度所發表之年度報告 Form 10-K 文件之「第二部分，第 7 項，管理層討論與分析財務狀況及營運結果」，該文件已於 2024 年 12 月 19 日向 SEC 提交，並可在 SEC 網站 www.sec.gov 查閱。
我們意圖透過後續對本公司財務狀況及營運結果之說明，提供資訊以協助讀者瞭解本公司合併財務報表、這些財務報表中某些關鍵項目之年對年變動，以及造成這些變動的主要因素，以及某些會計原則、會計政策及會計估計如何影響本公司合併財務報表。此說明應與本公司合併財務報表及相關附註說明一併閱讀，這些附註說明出現在本文件其他地方。
•趨勢與不確定性。討論管理層所知之重大事件與不確定性，例如總體經濟環境混亂及全球貿易限制加劇、我們產品組閤中需求不均、對新技術之需求與採用增加、存貨水準上升、保守的客戶支出環境（雖已復甦）、持續通貨膨脹、外匯壓力、近期稅務發展，以及競爭性價格壓力。
•執行摘要。討論我們之業務，以及我們財務表現及其他重點摘要，包括非 GAAP 財務指標，以提供對 MD&A 其餘部分之背景資訊。
•關鍵會計政策與估計。討論我們認為對理解我們報告財務結果所採用之會計政策與估計，以及所包含之假設與判斷。
•營運結果。討論合併層面之營運結果後，再討論各應報告分部之營運結果。
•流動性與資本資源。分析我們現金流量、財務狀況、流動性及現金需求與承諾之變動。
•GAAP 至非GAAP 會計項目之差異說明。每項非GAAP 會計項目均已與最直接可比之GAAP 會計項目進行差異說明。本節亦包含對非GAAP 會計項目之使用、實用性及經濟本質之討論，以及對使用非GAAP 會計項目所涉及之重大限制及其補償措施之說明。
在財務年度2025年，總體經濟環境的變化對需求的影響持續存在，且某些重大發展已影響我們的營運，如下所述：

科技進步：我們觀察到市場趨勢與需求（來自不同規模與部門之客戶）逐漸朝向AI、混合雲、邊緣計算、資料安全能力及相關產品與服務。邊緣處的資料量持續成長，這是由於裝置數量的增加所驅動。同時，對統一雲端體驗的需求也增加，以管理邊緣處資料的成長。對AI需求的增加也導致競爭格局的變化。在資料充足的情況下，有機會開發具強大計算能力的AI工具，以從所捕捉的資料中提取見解與價值。為AI工作負載而設計的安全網路是基礎，使用戶能順暢連接並應用AI學習成果至存於不同生態系統中的資料。雖然我們認為最近收購Juniper Networks使我們能把握AI加速計算、資料、雲端與網路領域的成長市場機會，但我們的主要競爭對手與新興競爭對手正擴展其產品與服務組合，提供整合性產品與解決方案，並施加更大的競爭壓力。我們預期這些市場動態與趨勢將在長遠持續。
HEWLETT PACKARD ENTERPRISE COMPANY AND SUBSIDIARIES

總體經濟不確定性：總體經濟環境的變化已影響產業整體需求，客戶花費較長時間處理先前訂單，且至今仍採用更戰略性的方法來進行非必要資訊科技支出。雖然這種動態已有所緩和，但導致我們產品組合與地理區域的需求不均，特別是某些硬體產品，因為客戶已將投資重點放在現代化基礎設施上，例如遷移至雲端服務，包括我們自己的服務。此外，關於關稅環境與進出口規則的不確定性持續存在，這是因為多種因素，包括但不限於關稅實施的延遲、關稅率與政策的變動，以及全球各地實行相互限制性貿易政策與措施。這些因素已增加全球貿易的不確定性，並導致零組件與終端產品與服務的價格上漲。儘管我們已透過依賴全球供應鏈並實施定價措施來緩解這些不利影響，我們預期這種混合的總體經濟環境將持續，並可能在短期內限制營收與毛利率的成長。

供應鏈：我們經歷了某些零組件的供應鏈限制，包括圖形處理單元（"GPUs"）與加速處理單元。雖然在財務年度中間曾一度緩解，但我們又再次面臨這些限制，預期這種動態將在中長期持續。未來仍存在不確定性，這是因為上述總體經濟動態已影響我們進口與出口零組件與成品的能力與相關成本。此外，物流成本已高，且可能持續保持高水準，這是因為貿易政策的變動。我們經歷了高於正常水準的存貨，主要原因是零組件頻繁更新、客戶轉向下一代GPUs、我們為應對需求而提前確保供應，以及客戶對AI相關訂單的接受週期較長。儘管我們正在努力減少存貨，上述任何或所有因素都可能導致存貨持續高於正常水準，並增加進一步的不確定性。我們經歷了，且預期將持續經歷，因多種因素導致的輸入零組件成本上升，包括但不限於上述提及的全球貿易不確定性與競爭性定價環境，所有這些都可能影響我們的財務結果。我們計畫透過持續嚴謹的成本與定價管理及供應鏈多元化來緩解這些動態的影響；然而，這些措施可能無法成功。

本公司所處產業為高度競爭產業，競爭壓力可能損害本公司業務及財務表現。
不確定性及總體經濟條件的波動可能對本公司的業務、財務狀況及營運成果產生負面影響。
若我們遭遇或未能妥善管理產品與服務的配送中斷，將可能影響本公司的業務與財務表現。
業務中斷可能嚴重影響我們未來的營收與財務狀況，並增加我們的成本與費用。
我們產品與服務的長銷售與實施週期，以及與大額訂單相關的動態，可能導致我們的營收與營運成果在季度之間產生顯著變動。
我們不均的銷售週期與供應鏈中斷，使規劃與存貨管理困難，並使未來財務結果較難預測。
paragraphs: 您應仔細評估本年度報告表 10-K 中所列之風險及其他資訊，以評估惠普企業。任何下列風險都可能對我們的營運結果或財務狀況造成重大且不利的影響。下列所討論之因素、事件及潛在問題，有些可能已發生於過去，但以下披露內容並非表示這些因素、事件或潛在問題是否已發生於過去，而是反映我們對這些因素、事件或潛在問題可能對我們未來造成重大且不利影響的觀點。請配合本年度報告表 10-K 第二部分，第 7 項「管理層對財務狀況與營運結果之討論與分析」，以及第二部分，第 8 項「財務報表與補充資料」中的合併財務報表與相關附註一併閱讀。
以下為可能對我們業務、營運及財務結果造成不利影響的主要風險總結。
•我們的成功取決於我們能否成功執行我們的市場推廣策略，包括提供即服務（as-a-Service）解決方案、有效規劃與管理我們的資源，以及持續開發與管理我們的產品，以整合新功能與解決方案。
•我們依賴第三方供應商、製造商（包括原始設備製造商與原始設計製造商），以及單一來源與有限來源供應商，若我們未能有效管理這些第三方關係，將可能影響我們的財務結果。
•系統安全風險、資料保護事件、網路攻擊與系統整合問題可能幹擾我們的內部營運或對客戶提供的資訊科技服務，任何此類幹擾都可能減少我們的營收、增加我們的費用、損害我們的聲譽，並對我們的股票價格造成不利影響。
